scale_cues: Square white plate, about 23-25 cm across, takes up about 360 px. Each cob piece is about 95-105 px wide, so about 6 cm across, which is a large ear of corn. The camera looks straight down, so I can't see the length of the pieces. I assumed 4-5 cm each based on how the cut ends look.
assumptions: The grams are only the kernels you can eat. Each piece with its cob would weigh about 75-90 g, and the cob is about 45-50% of that.
I used about 96 kcal and 3.4 g protein per 100 g of boiled sweet corn kernels.
I can't see butter, oil or salt, so I left them out. Buttered corn would add about 35-70 kcal.
No drinks or other items are visible.
